attempts.artifact:
TC-001: Controller Pre-Test Mode Support
  Preconditions: Controller is in normal mode.
  Steps: 
    - Issue command to enter pre-test mode.
  Expected: Controller enters pre-test mode without error.

TC-002: GUI Pre-Test Mode Support
  Preconditions: GUI is running and connected to controller.
  Steps:
    - Click pre-test mode button in GUI.
  Expected: GUI enters pre-test mode and displays pre-test status.

TC-003: Pre-Test Mode Execution
  Preconditions: Controller is in pre-test mode (entered via TC-001) or GUI is in pre-test mode (entered via TC-002).
  Steps:
    - Start pre-test mode (if not active).
    - Wait for pre-test completion.
  Expected: Pre-test completes without error (all checks executed successfully).

TC-004: Flow Sensor Accuracy (Positive)
  Preconditions: Blower set to predefined speed, air lines open, output disconnected.
  Steps:
    - Initiate self-test.
  Expected: Flow sensor reading matches expected flow value for blower speed (within system tolerance).

TC-005: Flow Sensor Accuracy (Negative: Air Lines Closed)
  Preconditions: Blower set to predefined speed, air lines closed, output disconnected.
  Steps:
    - Initiate self-test.
  Expected: Self-test fails with error message indicating air lines must be open.

TC-006: Flow Sensor Accuracy (Negative: Output Connected)
  Preconditions: Blower set to predefined speed, air lines open, output connected.
  Steps:
    - Initiate self-test.
  Expected: Self-test fails with error message indicating output must be disconnected.

TC-007: Pressure Sensor Accuracy (Positive)
  Preconditions: System pressurized to known pressure (as specified by system).
  Steps:
    - Initiate self-test.
  Expected: Pressure sensor reading matches expected pressure value (within system tolerance).

TC-008: Pressure Sensor Accuracy (Boundary)
  Preconditions: System pressurized to pressure at boundary of sensor operating range (as defined by system).
  Steps:
    - Initiate self-test.
  Expected: Pressure sensor reading matches expected pressure value at boundary (within system tolerance).
